## The xkcd comics used in this handbook

Every embedded xkcd comic is by Randall Munroe and is reused from [xkcd](https://xkcd.com/) under the [Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial 2.5 licence](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/2.5/). The comics are excluded from the handbook's CC BY 4.0 content licence. Each appearance links to the original comic and explains why it was selected for that page.
